SELECT TOP 50 A.CustomerId, A.CustomerType, D.FORACID, D.GAM_ACID, D.GAM_SCHM_CODE, D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, D.Conversion_Rate,
 D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
FROM dw.DimCustomer_BU_20240119 A
INNER JOIN dw.DimCustomerAccount_BU_20240119 B
ON A.CustomerSK = B.CustomerSK
INNER JOIN dw.DimBank C
ON B.BankSK = C.BankSK
INNER JOIN dw.DEPOSITS_FACT D
ON B.AccountID = D.FORACID 
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN A.ValidStartDate AND A.ValidEndDate
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN B.ValidStartDate AND B.ValidEndDate
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN C.ValidStartDate AND C.ValidEndDate
WHERE A.CustomerType = 'Retail'
AND B.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND C.BankID = 'CBC01'
AND D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP > 10000 --IS NULL 
--AND D.Conversion_Rate IS NOT NULL
--AND D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE DESC




--Checking of Customers in Dep Fact and Dim
SELECT CustomerID, a.AccountID, ShareIndicator, AccountStatus, FORACID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, Conversion_Rate,
OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 
YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP, a.ValidStartDate, a.ValidEndDate,
c.ValidStartDate, c.ValidEndDate, b.as_of_date
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_BU_20240119 a
INNER JOIN
DW.DEPOSITS_FACT b 
ON a.AccountID = b.FORACID
AND b.as_of_date BETWEEN a.ValidStartDate AND a.ValidEndDate
INNER JOIN
DW.DimAccount_BU_20240119 c 
ON c.AccountID = b.FORACID
AND b.as_of_date BETWEEN c.ValidStartDate AND c.ValidEndDate
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00890918'
ORDER BY a.AccountID DESC
